title: Council Regulation (EU) 2026/2632 of 25 November 2026 amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine

sections.heading: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 1

paras.text: Having regard to Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2622 of 25 November 2026 amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine ( 1 ) ,

paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 4

amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 8

paras.text: Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 gives effect to certain measures provided for in Council Decision 2014/512/CFSP ( 3 ) .
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 9
amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 10

paras.text: On 25 November 2026, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2026/2622, which amends Decision 2014/512/CFSP.
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 11
amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 12

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2026/2622 adds 15 entities to Annex IV to Decision 2014/512/CFSP. Those entities are entities which form part of Russia’s military and industrial complex or which have commercial or other links with or otherwise support Russia’s military and industrial complex or its defence and security sector. Tighter export restrictions regarding dual-use goods and technology, as well as regarding goods and technology which might contribute to the technological enhancement of Russia’s defence and security sector, are imposed on those entities.
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 13
amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 14

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2026/2622 removes from Annex IV an entity incorporated in a third country other than Russia.
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 15
amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 16

paras.text: These measures fall within the scope of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and therefore, in particular with a view to ensuring their uniform application in all Member States, regulatory action at the level of the Union is necessary.
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 17
amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 18

paras.text: Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 19

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS REGULATION:
paras.loc: amending Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of , para 20

paras.text: Annex IV to Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 is amended in accordance with the Annex to this Regulation.
This Regulation shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
This Regulation shall be binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
Done at Brussels, 25 November 2026.
For the Council
The President
T. BYRNE
